caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice and a full, floor-length skirt. It features very large, puffed sleeves that are gathered at the shoulders and taper down to narrow cuffs at the wrists. The dress has a high neckline with a contrasting white collar fastened at the throat with a circular brooch or button. The fabric of the dress is patterned with an intricate and symmetrical design consisting primarily of repeating floral and scroll motifs in shades of green, pink, white, and purple on a mauve or dusty rose background. There is a decorative ruffle across the yoke of the bodice, and pleats at the waist give volume to the skirt. The composition of the drawing places the dress centrally on a plain, beige background, with no visible figure or additional objects present.
title: House Dress
